personality_one_liner: A warm, literary, premium local marketplace — modernism and subtle glassmorphism over a deep Ink-green atmosphere, with book covers providing the color.

typography.rule: Editorial contrast: Fraunces (serif) for major headings and emotional/literary moments (screen titles, onboarding, welcome). DM Sans (sans) for everything else — body, navigation, buttons, metadata, forms, filters, labels. Do not use serif everywhere; BookLoop should feel like a reading product, not a banking app.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial spacing. Use md to lg for component gaps, and xl or 2xl for page margins. Avoid cramped elements.

radius_tokens.rule: Pills are for filters, genres, statuses, location, compact actions. Cards keep structured geometry — avoid making every component pill-shaped.

shadow_tier: 1 — soft only. Reserve visible shadow for the primary CTA (subtle terracotta-tinted glow) and floating elements (Add Book FAB). Cards rely on the glass border, not shadow, for separation.

do's: Subtle, functional glass: dark translucent fill + thin low-contrast border + very soft shadow, via the shared GlassSurface component.
Use for: search bars, filter pills, profile/people/book cards, auth fields, modal sheets, action panels, OTP fields, password fields, welcome screen elements.

Reserve real BlurView for static surfaces (search bar, modals, auth/welcome backgrounds). Inside scrolling lists (FlatList rows, horizontal chip scrollers) use the flat translucent fill without blur — same visual result, no per-item blur cost.
dont's: No bright/high-opacity glass, huge blur radii, neon borders, or strong reflections — not an Apple Vision Pro imitation.
Readability comes first: never let glass reduce text contrast below comfortable reading levels.

screens.name: Auth / Onboarding
screens.purpose: Welcomes users with the cozy, indie-bookstore vibe and handles login.

states.error: Standard inline error text for forms.

screens.layout: Full-bleed atmospheric background image (bookstore interior) with a gradient scrim from transparent top to deep Ink-dark bottom. A glass card (GlassSurface, panel radius) holds the brand wordmark (serif), tagline, and a large Terracotta primary CTA over glass form inputs.

screens.name: Verify Email / OTP
screens.purpose: Six-digit code entry after Sign Up, before password creation.

states.loading: Inline spinner on the Verify button while checking the code.
states.error: Concise inline error text (incorrect code, expired, too many attempts) — never an aggressive full-field red state.

screens.layout: Large serif heading ("Verify your email"), explanatory sans body copy, six separate glass OTP boxes, resend timer/link beneath. Subtle progress indicator showing Account -> Verify -> Password. Should still read as BookLoop, not a banking OTP screen.

screens.name: Create Password
screens.purpose: Password creation after successful email verification.
screens.layout: Glass password + confirm-password fields with show/hide toggles. Live requirement checklist (8+ chars, upper, lower, number, special) — satisfied items in Sage, unsatisfied in muted neutral. Terracotta primary CTA, enabled only once client-side requirements pass (server independently re-validates).

screens.name: Welcome
screens.purpose: One-time, first-registration-only welcome moment before entering Discover.
screens.layout: Atmospheric background (blurred books/plants/light), generous whitespace, serif emotional headline ("Welcome to BookLoop, {firstName}."), a short literary supporting line, Terracotta "Start exploring" CTA, subtle "Read. Swap. Repeat." brand line. Gentle fade/slide entrance only — no confetti, no badges, no gamification.

screens.name: Discover
screens.purpose: Primary marketplace feed showing local people and books.

states.loading: Skeleton cards mimicking user rows and book tiles.
states.empty: Illustration of vintage books with 'No active exchangers nearby'.
states.error: Error message with a retry button.

screens.layout: Location control + notifications/profile up top. Large serif editorial headline ("Discover people and their books.") with a supporting sans sentence. Glass search field, glass filter pills. 'People near you' as glass PersonCards (avatar, name, exchanging dot, distance, rating + swap count, genre chips, mini book-cover preview). 'Popular books nearby' as a book-cover-led grid — the cover is the hero, minimal chrome.

screens.name: Map
screens.purpose: Explore neighborhood-level book density and active swappers.

states.loading: Map loading state with central spinner.
states.error: Location permission error with a settings CTA.

screens.layout: Full-screen map with Sage marker/cluster treatment integrated into the dark theme. Overlay controls use dark glass. Tapping a cluster triggers a Bottom Sheet (gorhom/bottom-sheet, glass) revealing a serif headline ('342 people nearby...'), popular genre tags, and an 'Explore People' CTA. Map functionality itself is unchanged by the visual pass.

screens.name: My Books
screens.layout: Serif editorial header. Sticky glass filter chips (Available, Reserved, Swapped). 2-column grid of book covers as the visual hero, minimal text beneath, subtle status tag (Sage for Available, muted for Swapped).

screens.name: Swaps
screens.purpose: Manage active, incoming, and completed exchange requests.
screens.layout: List of conversations (avatar, name, requested book cover thumbnail, last message) over dark surfaces. Inside chat: message bubbles + structured, special-but-not-flashy glass 'Swap Action Cards' embedded in the timeline. Status colors stay accessible on dark.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: View and edit personal details and swap history.
screens.layout: Large rounded avatar, name, location, rating badge. Subtle glass statistics. 'Currently exchanging' toggle prominently placed. Book grid prioritizing covers. Genre chips, languages, swap history below, clean list-based layout.

screens.name: Add Book Flow
screens.purpose: Quick, multi-step form to list a new book.
screens.layout: Full-screen modal/sheet over dark glass. Step 1: cover photo upload (large square target). Step 2: title & author (glass text fields). Step 3: condition. Sticky 'Next/Submit' button anchored to the keyboard.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design for the 'Dark Premium Editorial' personality: deep Ink-green atmosphere (not flat black), subtle functional glassmorphism, generous spacing, high typographic hierarchy.
Use Fraunces (serif) only for major headings and emotional/literary moments. Use DM Sans for everything else (body, labels, buttons, metadata, filters).
The core background is a darkened Deep Ink (#101614). Elevated surfaces (cards, sheets, glass) lighten from there — see the surface/surfaceSecondary/surfaceTertiary/surfaceInverse ramp.
Glass surfaces go through the shared GlassSurface component: real BlurView for static surfaces, flat translucent fill (no blur) inside scrolling lists.

Navigation: 5-item bottom tab bar, physically LTR in every language including Arabic. The middle-ish item is a floating '+ Add Book' Terracotta button positioned above Profile. Never change this order or mirror it under RTL.
Terracotta is reserved for the one important action on a screen — do not recolor every button orange.
People Cards (Discover tab): avatar, name, exchanging Sage dot, distance, rating + swap count on top; genre chips; horizontal scroll of mini book covers below, all on a glass surface.
Book Grids: the cover image is the hero and brings color into the dark UI; keep text underneath minimal and clean.
Ensure all primary buttons (Terracotta) are pinned to the bottom of the screen with proper safe area padding, outside of the ScrollView.
Avoid any blue, purple, or indigo shades completely as per the no-tolerance color rule.
